storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Black veils, and beneath the robes Miryam's body, worn down to the bone.
She makes no sound. Devotion and grief are woven together in her face, like a Madonna in a mural, heavy with a mystery no one can read.
Everything she has, she pours into waiting for one particular moment.
It is close now. The appointed day is almost here...

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
The rumors of humans landing in the polar regions have intensified this century. In response, Mythag University and the Mystia Treaty Committee have collaborated to form a joint investigation team.

In December of A.F. 3@1, the joint investigation team ventured deep into the Elworth ice fields with the aim of recovering potential mystical artifacts before the arrival of secular expedition teams.

......

On December 10, A.F. 3@1, Investigator Johansson accidentally fell into an ice cave, discovering a hollow space beneath the ice field. The altitude is too low; the melting ice will submerge the hollow within three days. We must complete our exploration before temperatures continue to rise.

On December 12, A.F. 3@1, there are reasons to believe that a cult has long used the hollow as a sacrificial pit. At the bottom of the cave, we discovered countless humanoid skeletons. Yes, humanoid—with cartilaginous fins connected to their skulls.

......

On December 13, A.F. 3@1, damn, damn, damn, damn! At the peak of the bone mountain, the investigator discovered the recent remains of a human!!!

The cult may not have yet withdrawn from the polar region. Due to the Committee's foolish "persistence," no Awakener investigators were permitted to accompany us. We must leave immediately!

——"Motion on Blockading the Wild Sea Route: Part One"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Miryam leads a plain, ascetic life on campus. Solitude, contemplation, silent prayer, cleaning, labor—the same round, day after day.
The awe and wariness of others, the gossip, the curiosity: she meets it all with indifference. On a campus far from her homeland, she seems to have found a new form of spiritual discipline.
In truth, she does not mind talking at all. Spare her a little of your time and she will tell you of the greatness of that immortal god, of the distant civilization that stood before history and the eternal kingdom its wise young king ruled. Whenever she speaks of it, her eyes fill with a pity her listeners have never seen before.
Worth noting: Miryam holds an unusual devotion and reverence toward Tulu, though Tulu has never treated her as anything special.
If you ever need to negotiate with Miryam, asking Tulu for help may turn things in your favor.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
She was born before human history was written, in an old civilization no record can confirm today.
There, the children of the stars raised glorious kingdoms and temples to an immortal god. She grew up inside that faith, devout from childhood, set on becoming an apostle of the divine.
But a god's calling is not so easily won. She hungered for miracles and visions, and not once did she see them.
Not until Tulu took the throne, and her diligence at last lifted her to High Priestess—the moment she would never forget, when a deep, reeling joy flooded her soul and set her spirit trembling.
At last she had seen a miracle; at last she understood the truth of it. This young king was the very thing she had hungered for: the immortal made flesh among mortals.
Years later the great flood came and drowned the civilization. She heard from Tulu the last prophecy of the immortal, then returned to the temple and prayed until the final moment.
Ages came and went, seas turned to land, a new humanity spread across the earth, and no one remembered anything from before.
And from there, Miryam's trial had only just begun.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Those who have never been called are pitiable, for they cannot grasp what immortality truly means. Worldly strife is meaningless, a shallow diversion along the way.
I have looked upon it. I have tasted it. I have long known what this body is for.
And yet, and yet... how cruel fate is! Why did You... not choose Your most faithful priestess again?
—No. You are setting me a trial. You are testing my faith. In the place furthest from my homeland, in all the hours without Your grace, my faith has passed through ten thousand years and never changed.
I was not the one who welcomed Your rebirth, but I have prepared everything for it. I will find You another eternal realm... The bitterness and the honor are both mine, and I must carry this duty alone...
Forgive my ugly envy. If I may look upon Your majesty once more, if I may raise Your kingdom again, there is nothing I would not do.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: A mere drop in the tides, a shallow follower of the immortal, Miryam... greets you.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Have you acknowledged my wish?

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Closer... ever closer to my lord...

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: I shall not forget what you've contributed for my reunion with Him...

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: I have been called; the line between god and supplicant now bleeds.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Bathed in such sacred radiance... Is this the divine power He holds? So boundless... so sublime...

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Brighter... and clearer...

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: The gate to His realm is almost within reach.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: May He guide me into His sanctuary, where His serenity covers my dreams...

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I have been wholly restored as an Awakener... Now the Divine Realm's chorus resonates within me...

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: The ecstasy of being illuminated by His glory is beyond your faithless comprehension... May He, in His mercy, forgive your blindness and impudence.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: We are all wretched mortals in the dust, but the Sage walks apart. He is the Emissary, a divine incarnation. His counsel echoes with the voices of gods, steering our frail civilization toward immortality... I do not expect your hollow mind to grasp devotion now, but one day, you too shall kneel before His throne.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: The Chosen are blessed indeed, don't you agree? Their flesh has been remade by His holy will, their lives extended beyond mortal measure. When He strides upon the shore, they will rise as His choir. Isn't this the utmost sweetness and highest happiness for mortals frail as sands?

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Perhaps I was too hasty to dismiss you as merely mortal. How does one untouched by grace still cling to purpose? This is Miryam's curiosity, not a question from the Holy Mother of the Seas. Will you... indulge me?

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: How could one as extraordinary as you not tire of this transient, tumultuous world? You shall find your rightful home in the eternal realm. There, your feet will kiss the hallowed ground, your breaths will be renewed in sacred waters, and your soul will flourish in blessed earth... You will join me in this holy pilgrimage. Join me in this holy pilgrimage. Together we'll rise far beyond mortal bounds, till we stand united at the Throne, and taste the ripened joy in its light...

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: This shell should not stir for anyone but Him... And yet... your warmth...

daily.title: Chat: About Past
daily.content: I am no one of consequence, merely one devoted soul among countless. I have dedicated my life to that magnificent presence, and I shall never cease to offer my all to earn but a glance.

daily.title: Chat: About Goliath
daily.content: He was a worthy blade. I once named him "comrade"... Do you take issue with my choice of word? Then by all means, enlighten me.

daily.title: Chat: About Murphy
daily.content: False idols, brittle as dried clay, scatter at the slightest wind...

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Humans, false gods, Awakeners, even the Dissolution... All will serve as the foundation for my rebuilding of the Divine Realm.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: The mortal clamor wearies me. A quiet alcove in this academy would suffice... No, I don't need a fireplace. Only austerity can carry my prayers to Him...

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Please allow me to place an altar to His likeness in this place. It is a statue shaped by pious hands and bears no curses.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Historians who declare the Divine Realm's demise are tedious in their presumptions... Yet mere words are meaningless foams; none shall halt the glorious restoration.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Since He has deemed you worthy, I shall no longer consider you an adversary.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Clearing the path for His glorious return...

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: May my prayers toll like morning bell, rousing the slumbering homeland...

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Why? My lord, why do you still... resist awakening?

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: I must not falter before your arrival, my lord...

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Sacrifice! Return my flesh to His throne—

traphase.title: Chat: About Goliath

traphase.title: Chat: About Tulu
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase

traphase.title: Chat: About Faros
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
